user.title: Petrolmate fuel prices
user.description: Find the cheapest and closest fuel near a person, phone or zone. Prices come from petrolmate.com.au (no API key needed).

data_description.location_entity: A phone tracker or person follows you around; a zone stays put. Falls back to home when the entity has no GPS.
data_description.radius: Maximum distance. The API returns the nearest 50 stations, so in a city the real reach is usually smaller.
data_description.states: Where you usually fill up. Decides which station brands are offered when you set up where each fuel brand is sold, and for discounts.
data_description.networks: The fuel brands you want. Which station brands sell each one is under "Where each fuel brand is sold".

error.no_fuels: Pick at least one fuel type.
error.no_networks: Pick at least one fuel brand.

data_description.scan_interval: Prices only change every few hours; movement triggers its own refresh.

brands.title: Where each fuel brand is sold
brands.description: The station brands (the name on the shop) that sell each fuel brand. Stations of any brand not listed here count as **Other**. Brands found near you show how many stations in the list; you can also type a name.

data_description.reset: Replace every list below with the built-in defaults when you submit (e.g. Shell: Shell, OTR, Reddy Express, Coles Express).

discounts.title: My discounts
discounts.description:
Discounts lower the price shown and can change which station is cheapest. Each one gets a switch, on when added — turn it off when you don't have the docket or voucher.

{list}

discount.title: Discount
discount.description: Most discounts depend on the shop (e.g. the Coles docket works at Reddy Express but not OTR), so pick station brands, not fuel brands.

data_description.name: Shown on the card, e.g. Coles docket.
data_description.brands: Station brands where it's accepted. Pick or type.
data_description.stacks: Turn on for in-store offers that add to a docket (e.g. Reddy Express $20 spend). Otherwise only the best single discount applies at a station.
